description: NaTaN₂ is Caswellsilverite structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent N³⁻ atoms to form distorted NaN₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent TaN₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaN₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent TaN₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 13°. All Na-N bond lengths are 2.50 Å. Ta⁵⁺ is bonded to six equivalent N³⁻ atoms to form TaN₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaN₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaN₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent TaN₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 13°. All Ta-N bond lengths are 2.11 Å. N³⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Ta⁵⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NNa₃Ta₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
